title: Catalog refresh and clearer specifications
summary: Refreshed the complete JLCPCB Basic and Preferred Extended catalog: 1,586 parts, including 351 Basic and 1,235 Preferred Extended.
changes: Updated 1,574 stock counts and 1,582 price records. No parts were added or removed, and no tiers or packages changed.
Corrected diode categorization so an IC mentioning ESD protection is not treated as a diode.
Corrected channel labels on 40 TVS parts and the current label for C27147. Removed the disputed current rating from C2500 rather than choosing between conflicting source values.
Clarified MOSFET gate-voltage coverage and LED test-current guidance. Preserved manufacturer-backed limits and historical review dates.
caveat: Catalog collection is separate from editorial or datasheet review. Our Picks retains its August 19, 2026 review date. Prices and stock are snapshots; verify current availability, ratings, and suitability before ordering.

sources.label: Full refresh review and unresolved source conflicts
